items.event: US Open: Shelton vs. Tiafoe (men's SF)
items.line: All-American men's semifinal at Arthur Ashe — Shelton, fresh off a five-set upset of Alcaraz, faces Tiafoe with an American man guaranteed a Slam final for the first time since 2024.

sources.name: ESPN
sources.title: How Shelton defeated Alcaraz -- and what it means for the US Open

items.line: Aryna Sabalenka, chasing a third straight US Open title, meets the winner to emerge from a semifinal field that had all four women's top seeds — Pegula, Rybakina and Gauff included — for the first time since 1975.

sources.name: Sky Sports
sources.title: US Open 2026: Order of Play and match schedule for Arthur Ashe Stadium, Louis Armstrong Stadium and more

items.line: Shelton or Tiafoe plays for the title — the first American man in a major final since Taylor Fritz in 2024, with a shot at ending the men's Slam drought stretching back to Andy Roddick's 2003 US Open win.

sources.name: ESPN
sources.title: Tiafoe, Michelsen, Shelton lead U.S. march into Open quarters

items.line: Premier League's first Manchester derby of the season at Old Trafford — City arrive with a perfect start and top the table; United, mid-table, look to spoil it at home.

sources.name: Manchester City FC
sources.title: Man United v Man City - 13 Sept 2026
